# Tauri Project

This is a Tauri 2 desktop application (it replaced the earlier Neutralinojs and
Electrobun versions). The Preact UI runs in the system WebView2 and talks to
the native Rust side through `@tauri-apps/api` and Tauri plugins.

IMPORTANT: do **not** use Electron, Electrobun or Neutralinojs APIs or patterns.
All native functionality goes through the wrappers in `src/services/native.ts`,
which call the Tauri APIs and the Rust commands in `src-tauri/src/main.rs`.

## Documentation

- Tauri 2 guides: https://v2.tauri.app/start/
- JavaScript API reference: https://v2.tauri.app/reference/javascript/api/
- Permissions / capabilities: https://v2.tauri.app/security/capabilities/

## Layout

- `src/` — Preact frontend (built by Vite into `browser/`)
- `src-tauri/src/main.rs` — window placement, hide-on-close, system tray,
  notification AppUserModelID registration, and the `launch_args` /
  `show_window` commands
- `src-tauri/capabilities/default.json` — permissions granted to the webview.
  Add the matching permission here when calling a new window/plugin API.
- `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` — antimalware build; `tauri.fw.conf.json`
  overrides it for the firewall build

## Quick Reference

Common tasks you will need while maintaining XvirusUI:

- Show open file dialog (`@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog`, permission `dialog:allow-open`)
  ```ts
  const file = await open({ title: 'Select file', multiple: false });
  ```
- Window controls (`@tauri-apps/api/window`, permissions `core:window:allow-*`)
  ```ts
  await getCurrentWindow().minimize();
  await getCurrentWindow().hide();
  ```
- Notifications (`@tauri-apps/plugin-notification`, permission `notification:default`)
  ```ts
  sendNotification({ title: 'Hello', body: 'world' });
  ```
- Call a Rust command (`@tauri-apps/api/core`)
  ```ts
  const args = await invoke<string[]>('launch_args');
  ```
- System tray: built in Rust (`TrayIconBuilder` in `src-tauri/src/main.rs`).
- Draggable title bar: add `data-tauri-drag-region` to the element.
